targets.label: Return from smoothed price
targets.formula: y = 10,000 log(P_actual / P_smoothed); P_hat = P_smoothed exp(y_hat / 10,000)
targets.description: Return-regression variant of ETF-adjusted fair value: predict a return from the smoothed historical price using the selected factors. The smoothed anchor (P0) uses time weighting; it is not rebuilt with volume weighting.

targets.label: Change from previous price
targets.formula: y = P_actual − P_previous; P_hat = P_previous + y_hat
targets.description: Previous-price regression: predict a price-point change from the previous observed transaction. This configurable variant does not exactly refit the saved benchmark.

targets.label: Correction to ETF-adjusted value
targets.formula: y = P_actual − P_ETF_adjusted; P_hat = P_ETF_adjusted + y_hat
targets.description: ETF-adjusted fair value + regression: predict the remaining price-point error after the ETF adjustment. The saved ETF-adjusted value (P1) is a fixed anchor with coefficient one.

notes: Experiments are exploratory. September has already been inspected in prior research; repeated workbench comparisons do not create an untouched holdout.
All rows use 10:00 ≤ Eastern time < 15:30 and the zero-second TRACE availability assumption. Execution time is not a verified dissemination timestamp.

Saved B3, P1 and integrated predictions are scored on exactly the custom test rows. They retain their own training histories and P0/P1 calibration; changing the lab window refits the custom regression only.
Controls are reconstructed by the newer return study; these variants are not exact refits of archived B3. Evaluation P0/P1 and ETF horizons come from the active dashboard snapshot.

January–February are training-only history. Their P0/P1 anchors use the saved first-fold calibration fitted before March evaluation, like the integrated model's fitted training inputs. They are never reported as out-of-sample predictions.
Daily Treasury inputs are lagged by date. Sector, rating, category liquidity and calculated duration use current reference terms; enable retrospective metadata explicitly to fit these inputs.
Sector/rating/liquidity filters describe current-reference cohorts even when those attributes are excluded from the regression.

Monthly walk-forward refits use earlier available labels only. Rolling uses the previous N calendar months; expanding retains all history after an N-month warm-up. The first coverage month can be partial. Sparse months are reported as skipped.
